events.label: AI for Good Global Commission launched

slots.name: weapons directive deadline
slots.sentence: The memorandum is organized around four pillars (adoption, adaptation, assurance, and accountability), directs an update to DOD Directive 3000.09 on autonomous weapons within 90 days, proposes an AI National Security Strategic Reserve staffed by private-sector talent, and orders termination of contracts with AI companies that repeatedly limit how the government uses their products.

slots.name: signing date
slots.sentence: U.S. President Donald Trump also signed a National Security Presidential Memorandum on AI in the National Security Enterprise on June 5, which rescinded and replaced the Biden-era NSPM-25.
